faq.title: Everything you want to know
faq.subtitle: If your question isn't here, email us at soporte@sugarcheck.org.
faq.a1: Yes. You can create your account and start logging your information at no cost.
faq.q2: Is it for kids and adults?
faq.a2: Yes. The app is designed with children with diabetes and their families in mind, but anyone who needs to track glucose and insulin can use it.
faq.q3: Do I need a glucose sensor?
faq.a3: No. You can log your readings manually. If you use a glucose meter or sensor, you can also enter the values in SugarCheck.
faq.a4: Your health data is handled with reinforced security measures and only with your consent. You can read all the details in our privacy policy.
